definitions.gloss: sleep deprivation; lack of sleep; insufficient sleep
definitions.explanation: a condition of not getting enough sleep

examples.japanese: {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: I have a headache from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}し→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If sleep deprivation continues, you become prone to falling ill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慢性的|まんせいてき}な{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}まされている→悩ます：12602_nayamasu⟧。
examples.english: He suffers from chronic sleep deprivation.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧ (sleep) + {不足|ぶそく} (insufficiency/shortage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧ - to remedy sleep deprivation
- {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ - sleep deprivation continues
- {慢性的|まんせいてき}な{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく} - chronic sleep deprivation

HEALTH EFFECTS:
Prolonged sleep deprivation can lead to:
- ⟦{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧ (decreased concentration)
- ⟦{免疫力|めんえきりょく}→免疫力：08599_menekiryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧ (weakened immune system)
- ⟦{生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}→生活習慣病：08620_seikatsushuukanbyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧ (increased risk of lifestyle diseases)
